rationale: The sole blocking finding, CR-001 (Module Cohesion: LiteLLM recovery logic appended to the 1478-line main.py), is resolved exactly per its recommendation. The LITELLM_MODELS_* constants, the cache-clear/fetch helper, initialize_litellm_models() and schedule_litellm_models_recovery() with its backoff loop were extracted into a new module, src/codemie/rest_api/litellm_models_recovery.py; main.py now only imports and calls it (commit 719e86d76, rebased to 81b0482c7). Verified via code-review-check.diff (227 lines, scoped to main.py and the new module only) and by re-running the affected tests: tests/codemie/rest_api/test_litellm_model_recovery.py, tests/codemie/rest_api/test_startup_integration.py, tests/codemie/rest_api/routers/test_common_healthcheck.py and tests/enterprise/litellm (540 passed), plus ruff check and ruff format --check clean on both touched files. No new finding introduced by the extraction. This was a human-checked fix-up round (sdlc-light does one orchestrated review, then a check against the brief), not a re-dispatched orchestrator; confidence stays low on the original review per its own rationale (no spec, so acceptance never ran), but the fix itself is unambiguous and directly verified so this check is recorded at high confidence.
